approval.request_rejected_duplicate: duplicate request for %(target)s rejected within 2-minute denial cooldown

doctor.bad_timeout: REFLECT_DOCTOR_TIMEOUT=%(value)r is not a positive number of seconds — the timeout is the probe's leash; it must not be broken
doctor.empty_spec: the doctor checklist is empty or not an array — an empty checklist is not a pass (zero-value guard): a checklist must exist for a reason
doctor.http_headers_not_object: `%(check)s` expect_headers must be a {header name: value} string object

doctor.probe_inconclusive: the probe is neither occupied nor free (%(error)s) — no silent pass allowed

doctor.spec_problems: doctor preflight: the spec has %(count)d problems
doctor.unknown_kind: unknown kind `%(kind)s` (supported: %(supported)s) — an unknown criterion is a silent pass

examples.gates_empty: gate roster is empty; example coverage cannot be established
examples.manifest_not_object: example manifest must be an object

facts.accept_bad_value: accepted key/value for %(key)s cannot contain | or newlines
facts.accept_cmd_failed: cannot accept `%(key)s`: cmd %(cmd)s exited with rc=%(rc)s — verify the command before writing to the ledger
facts.accept_usage: usage: facts.py --accept <key> <bare value> <replay command> <source> — manually register one fact (it lands in the ledger; the same replay gate then runs its cmd verbatim)
facts.accept_value_mismatch: cannot accept `%(key)s`: cmd stdout=%(actual)r does not match expected %(expected)r
facts.bad_bare_min: REFLECT_NAKED_MIN=%(value)r is not an integer ⇒ using the default %(default)d
facts.bare_number_unaccounted: %(file)s:%(line)d has a number %(number)s with no provenance — it is not in the ledger and has no [[key]] citation / provenance marker. Measure it into the ledger (with a replay command) and cite it, or confirm a harmless shape (version / port / date).
facts.block_consistent: the machine block of %(path)s matches a fresh render
facts.block_mismatch: the block in the document does not match the ledger ⇒ run `python3 zreflect/facts.py --render-doc`
facts.block_stale: the %(begin)s block of %(path)s does not match a fresh render ⇒ run --render-doc
facts.copied_value: %(file)s:%(line)d has a bare number %(value)s (belongs to `%(key)s`) => rewrite it as [[%(key)s]]
facts.doc_has_no_home: document `%(path)s` is not in the machine-block home table (known: %(known)s) — 'nothing to check' is not 'nothing is stale'
facts.doc_missing: document does not exist: %(path)s — a missing file must not count as a pass (zero-value guard)
facts.doc_missing_check: document %(path)s does not exist (--check must not pass just because the file is missing)
facts.doc_missing_render: %(path)s does not exist. Place the machine-block markers by hand once.
facts.doc_unreadable: doc unreadable: `%(path)s` (%(error)r) — bad encoding / permissions / a directory are config accidents, not 'stale block'
facts.doc_unwritable: cannot write the doc: `%(path)s` (%(error)r) — read-only / permissions / full disk are environment accidents, not 'stale block'
facts.empty_ledger: ledger is empty — empty is not a pass (zero-value guard): check whether measure_example() is broken
facts.hand_written_in_state: %(name)s:%(lineno)d is hand-written: %(text)s -- both measured documents render everything; rules belong in the RULES table, and a one-off decision belongs to the commit message
facts.ledger_missing: fact ledger (%(name)s) is missing. Run python3 zreflect/facts.py to measure first.
facts.ledger_why: fact ledger: each entry = a measured value + replay command + source. Do not edit by hand; run zreflect/facts.py.
facts.marker_swallowed_body: %(path)s has the marker literal mixed into the prose (%(begin)s) — rendering would swallow the block; refusing to write; markers may appear only at the block's ends
facts.markers_missing_render: %(path)s is missing the %(begin)s / %(end)s markers (place them by hand once on first rollout)
facts.measure_bad_shape: `measure()` returned %(count)d malformed entries: %(keys)s — every value must have the shape produced by `facts.fact()`. %(hint)s
facts.measure_module_missing: REFLECT_MEASURE_MODULE is not configured (set it in knobs.json; placeholder fallback is disabled)
facts.measure_module_where: the module must be importable from `zreflect/` (put it inside `zreflect/`, or set PYTHONPATH); if you are not sure it works, leave this knob unset
facts.measure_own_code_hint: this repo has %(dirs)s — that is your code, while the numbers above measure the toolkit itself. To measure your own project: set REFLECT_MEASURE_MODULE=<your module> in knobs.json (the module defines a measure() returning a dict of fact())
facts.measure_placeholder_used: measure_example() used; set REFLECT_MEASURE_MODULE for real repo (changing repos edits one key in knobs.json; falling back to the placeholder leaves the ledger empty)
facts.measure_shape_hint: write it as `from ledger import fact` then `return {"key": fact(value, "replay command", "source")}` — a bare value like `{"key": 12}` is rejected
facts.missing_key_cite: %(file)s:%(line)d cites a key that does not exist: `%(key)s`
facts.no_block_markers: document has no %(begin)s / %(end)s markers — not finding the block is not the same as the block being correct (zero-value guard)
facts.no_ledger_yet:
no ledger yet at %(name)s (path = REFLECT_FACTS, currently resolved to %(path)s)
       first confirm this repo's ledger path: check what REFLECT_FACTS is set to in knobs.json,
       then run the measurement: python3 zreflect/facts.py
       then run --render-doc to write the machine block into the document.
facts.note.bare_number_demo: deliberately ≥100, to demonstrate the bare-number rule
facts.note.core_seal: two-tier SHA-256 Merkle root of the shared core (replayed by registry.py --verify-seal)
facts.note.excludes_machine_block: excludes machine blocks: they are rendered into the documents, counting them would make the value go stale on every render
facts.note.measure_or_omit: if it cannot be measured it is not written — absent beats fake
facts.ok: Facts gate: OK (%(count)d facts; block consistent, no bare numbers, no bad citations)
facts.registry_mismatch:
registry reconciliation failed, refusing to render:
  · %(entries)s
facts.render_unchanged: the machine block of %(path)s is unchanged
facts.title: Facts gate
facts.unknown_command: unknown command `%(command)s` — run `--help` for the available ones (it measures nothing and writes nothing)
facts.usage: usage: facts.py [--render|--render-doc [file]|--check [file]|--get KEY|--init|--accept KEY VALUE CMD SOURCE|show [KEY]] (no argument = measure and write the ledger)
gate.forged_row_neutralised: ★ %(count)d rendered line(s) would have passed as machine rows and were held down (prefixed with `\`) — the value contains a line break, usually from a filename or document content
gate.platform_root: Gate platform. Repo root under check: %(root)s
gate.platform_usage: Usage: in your checker `from gate import selftest, require_nonempty`.
gate.require_nonempty: %(name)s: %(what)s is empty. An empty input is not "all pass" — either the collection logic is broken or the path is wrong. Fix the input, do not switch the gate off.
gate.selftest_empty_cases: the selftest case list for %(name)s is empty — all three tiers of cases are mandatory (0/0 is not a pass, it means "this selftest checked nothing")
gate.spec_unreadable: %(path)s cannot be read / is not valid JSON: %(error)s
gate.title.facts: check_facts (block consistency / bare numbers / bad citations)
gate.title.facts_replay: check_facts_replay (ledger cmd re-run verbatim: stdout must equal the value)
gate.title.i18n_cover: language-coverage gate (core carries no natural language)
gate.title.invariants: invariants gate (declarative: repo files must / must not contain a snippet)
gate.title.knobs: knobs (knob registry: the single roster of REFLECT_*)
gate.title.questions: check_questions (an open question must carry a runnable settling case)
gate.title.registry: registry (the data side of discovery-based rosters)
gate.title.snapshot: module-snapshot gate (a cross-module import of a mutable global is a stale copy)
guard.accepted_boundary: accepted %(accepted)d via --accept-changes: %(keys)s — the rest still refused.
guard.empty_ledger: no facts measured at all. An empty ledger is not a pass (zero-value guard).
guard.refuse_changed: this re-measure would change %(count)d fact values (unaccepted changes):
guard.refuse_changed_advice: ledger not written. Confirm each change is measured, not guessed (not missing input / not a broken instrument), then pass --accept-changes (or --accept-changes=k1,k2 per key).
guard.refuse_dropped: this re-measure would drop %(count)d facts (input missing?): %(keys)s
guard.refuse_dropped_advice: ledger not written. Either prepare the input, or pass --allow-drop explicitly (and record the dropped keys in HISTORY).
guard.write_target_gitignored: ledger target %(path)s is covered by .gitignore — writing there is writing nowhere (version control cannot see it; the hooks read a different ledger); drop that ignore rule, or set REFLECT_FACTS to a tracked location
guard.write_target_no_git: (not a git repo or git unavailable: skipping the gitignore check)
harness.all_can_red: found %(count)d gates, all of them can go red
harness.configurable_ok: all five names renamed, %(ok)d/%(total)d green; under default names [%(red)s] all red ⇒ nothing hard-coded
harness.empty_red_list: [FAIL] red list is empty — zero-value guard: without it this section proves nothing
harness.heading: Gate selftest (discovery roster):
harness.missing_file: [FAIL] %(file)s missing (registry named it, file is gone)
harness.no_gates_found: [FAIL] no gate discovered — zero-value guard: empty input is not a pass
harness.no_gates_in_fixture: [FAIL] no gate ran in the fixture
harness.no_machine_summary: [FAIL] %(file)s selftest lacks the machine summary line (=== N PASS / M FAIL ===)
harness.no_modules_found: [FAIL] no platform-module selftest discovered — zero-value guard
harness.no_plugins: [FAIL] plugin roster is empty — zero-value guard: hook.py / doctor must be listed
harness.no_probes: [FAIL] zero-language probe list is empty — zero-value guard
harness.no_selftest_entry: [FAIL] %(file)s has no --selftest (an unregistered gate is an unwatched gate)
harness.not_red_under_defaults: [FAIL] %(gate)s did NOT go red under default names ⇒ the rename test proves nothing about it
harness.plugins_heading: -- Pluggable plugins and named selftests (roster derived from registry) --
harness.zero_lang_heading: -- End-to-end zero-language (no pack ⇒ no natural language) --
harness.zero_lang_leak: [FAIL] %(file)s emitted %(count)d Chinese line(s): %(sample)s — no pack loaded yet it speaks a natural language; that is not green

history.bad_mode: invalid REFLECT_HISTORY_MODE=%(mode)r (expected file, fold, or folder)
history.empty_or_malformed: history document %(path)s is empty or lacks a # heading and prose entry
history.missing: no history document at %(path)s -- prose has no legal home then; point REFLECT_HISTORY at the file or folder, or set it to an empty value to state that this repo keeps no history at all (removing the knob does NOT work: it falls back to the default name and stays red)
history.off: no history document is configured (REFLECT_HISTORY blank) => prose has no legal home in this repo; state it and stand down
history.ok: history document %(path)s is declared and stays off every scan surface
history.on_scan_surface: the history document %(path)s is on a scan surface (REFLECT_DOCS / REFLECT_READMES / REFLECT_QUESTIONS / REFLECT_FACTS) -- its 'as it was then' lines would be judged as live state
history.title: History document
history.wrong_kind: history target %(path)s has wrong file type (expected %(expected)s for active REFLECT_HISTORY_MODE)
hookgate.commit_readmes_not_together: this commit touched a README without updating all declared READMEs together (CI runs the same criterion). Roster configurable: REFLECT_READMES.
hookgate.missing_root: missing repo root (the second argument must be an absolute path)
hookgate.not_a_suite_repo: '%(repo)s' has no zreflect/ — this is not a repo the suite was installed into, or GATE_REPO points at the wrong place
hookgate.repo_missing: repo root '%(repo)s' does not exist (the second argument must be an absolute path)
hookgate.unstaged_facts: `%(path)s` has unstaged changes — stage or discard them before committing so `--render-doc` does not render an unstaged ledger into the staged document
i18n.module_banner: i18n is a module (consumed by every gate and platform module); --selftest shows its selftest.
i18n.value_masquerades_contract: pack %(lang)s: value `%(key)s` line %(line)d masquerades as a machine row (%(value)r) — machine contracts must not be translated; reword this message
i18n_cover.bare_text: %(file)s:%(lineno)d bare natural-language text in the core %(text)r — user-facing messages must go through M(<literal code>, params); selftest labels must be ids per decision 1C
i18n_cover.code_not_literal: the code passed to `M(...)` must be a string literal (%(file)s:%(lineno)d, got %(kind)s) — a variable / conditional / concatenated code makes pack completeness unprovable
i18n_cover.empty_scan: scan surface is empty — finding no source is not a language-free pass (zero-value guard)
i18n_cover.filename_has_line_break: a file name in the scan surface contains a line break: %(file)s — once rendered into a message it can forge a machine row (same table as i18n.LINE_BREAKS)
i18n_cover.fixture_literal: `%(file)s:%(lineno)d` has a Chinese literal in a self-test fixture (%(text)r) — fixtures land in the scan surface; build them from codepoints (`chr(CJK_LO)` / `_cj(n)`) or use English-only samples
i18n_cover.non_ascii_prose: non-ASCII prose in %(file)s:%(lineno)d (%(chars)s): %(text)s -- source must read as English; ★ · ℹ ⚠️ → are protocol marks and are exempt, everything else is a typographic character that leaked into prose
i18n_cover.ok: Language coverage gate: OK (%(files)d files have a language-free core; language packs optional)
i18n_cover.parse_error: %(file)s cannot be parsed: %(error)s — a parse failure must not count as a pass
i18n_cover.scan_empty_dir: scan surface %(root)s is empty — finding no source is not a language-free pass
i18n_cover.title: Language coverage gate
install.chain_blocked_by_hookspath: refusing to install: this repo already has `core.hooksPath=%(value)s` — once git has that, it never looks at `.git/hooks`, so a wrapper written here would never run.
install.chain_blocked_fix: either call `python3 "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/reflect-local/hook.py" commit "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"` directly inside your custom hooksPath pre-commit script, or run `python3 reflect-local/hook.py --uninstall` then `--chain`.
install.chain_done: chained wrapper installed. undo: python3 reflect-local/hook.py --uninstall
install.chain_hint: for a ready-made hookup: python3 reflect-local/hook.py --chain
install.intro: Einfacht does not steal the hook seat — it exposes one entry point that your hook system calls itself:
install.kept_existing: kept the existing %(name)s as %(name)s.einfacht-prev (it runs before Einfacht)
install.not_a_repo: '%(path)s' is not a git repo (no .git found)
install.usage_chain: --chain      install chained wrapper in .git/hooks/pre-commit (and remove stale pre-push wrapper): an existing hook runs first, then Einfacht (no seat-stealing)
install.usage_no_target: no target repo root ⇒ installs into this repo (where the toolkit lives). Always pass it when installing elsewhere.
install.usage_uninstall: --uninstall  undo --chain (restore original hooks) and unset any legacy core.hooksPath
install.why_not_hookspath: why not core.hooksPath: it is a global override switch — once set, git ignores .git/hooks entirely, so husky / lefthook / pre-commit / hand-written hooks silently die (commits still succeed, no warning).
instruments.constant_return: `%(key)s` has not changed since %(first_seen)s (%(days).0f days, constant threshold %(threshold).0f days) — confirm by hand: is this cmd measuring, or returning the same number forever? (instrument-silent-drift check, issue #6 ①)
instruments.days_unparseable: %(days_knob)s=%(value)r cannot be parsed as a number of days — fix the config (or drop the knob)
instruments.entry_malformed: method registry entry has a malformed shape (text is required): %(entry)r
instruments.falsified_method: `%(key)s`'s cmd contains a falsified method fragment %(text)r (correct method in %(fixed_in)s) -- a broken measuring method must not stay in the ledger
instruments.first_seen_unparseable: `%(key)s` has an unparseable first_seen (%(first_seen)r) — the constant-value rule cannot be evaluated (if it cannot be read, say so; do not guess)
instruments.ledger_empty: ledger is empty — empty is not a pass (zero-value guard): first check whether measure() is broken
instruments.ledger_missing: ledger is missing: %(path)s — run facts.py first
instruments.off: Instrument lifecycle gate: neither %(days_knob)s nor %(instruments_knob)s is configured ⇒ this gate is off (pluggable module; to enable: %(days_knob)s=days turns on constant-value detection; %(instruments_knob)s=instruments.json registers falsified methods)
instruments.registry_missing: REFLECT_INSTRUMENTS=%(name)s is set but the registry file is absent — register first (or drop the knob)
instruments.title: Instrument lifecycle gate
invariants.bad_shape: spec file %(path)s has a bad shape: expected {"checks": [...]}
invariants.empty: the invariants list is empty — an empty list is not a pass (zero-value guard): a list exists only with reasons
invariants.no_criteria: `%(path)s` has no criteria (give at least one of must_contain / must_not_contain)
invariants.not_object: check item is not an object: %(entry)r
invariants.not_string_list: `%(path)s` must_contain / must_not_contain must be arrays of strings
invariants.off: Invariants gate: REFLECT_INVARIANTS not configured ⇒ this gate is off (pluggable module; to enable: REFLECT_INVARIANTS=invariants.json, spec = {"checks": [{path, must_contain?, must_not_contain?}]})
invariants.spec_missing: REFLECT_INVARIANTS=%(name)s is configured but the spec file is missing — write the spec (or drop the knob)
invariants.title: Invariants gate
invariants.unreadable: `%(path)s` cannot be read (does the file exist? paths are relative to the repo root) — say so when unreadable, never pass silently
knobs.config_corrupt: `%(path)s` cannot be read as a JSON object: %(error)s
knobs.config_invalid_value: `knobs.json` sets empty or non-string value for `%(knob)s`
knobs.inline_default_literal: `%(file)s:%(lineno)d` hardcodes fallback %(literal)r for `%(knob)s` outside `knobs.py` — defaults live only in `knobs.REGISTRY`; call `knobs.get(%(knob)r)`
knobs.module_only: knobs is a module (consumed by the gates); run --selftest for its self-test.
knobs.pack_brace_template: language pack %(lang)s: template `%(key)s` uses brace-style placeholders (%(text)s) -- rendering is percent-only, so braces reach the user verbatim
knobs.pack_extra_keys: Pack %(lang)s has keys absent from %(reference)s (the reference pack) -- key sets disagree: if %(lang)s is a declared service language (REFLECT_LANGS), its readers would see bare codes; packs outside REFLECT_LANGS are self-evidence samples, key-set drift does not block: %(keys)s
knobs.pack_missing_code: These codes the source emits are missing from the %(lang)s pack (%(count)d) -- %(lang)s is a declared service language (REFLECT_LANGS), its readers would see bare codes: %(codes)s
knobs.pack_missing_keys: Pack %(lang)s lacks %(count)d keys present in reference pack %(reference)s -- %(lang)s is in the declared service set (REFLECT_LANGS), those spots would render as bare codes: %(keys)s
knobs.pack_placeholder_mismatch: pack %(lang)s's `%(key)s` placeholder names differ from %(reference_lang)s (%(reference_lang)s: %(expected_params)s / %(lang)s: %(actual_params)s) — rendering would KeyError
knobs.pack_sync_empty: the language-pack directory holds no pack at all (%(pack_dir)s) — if REFLECT_I18N is set it must point at a directory that actually has packs: install one, or unset the knob (unsetting means: use the packs that ship with the toolkit)
knobs.pack_unreadable: pack %(lang)s could not be read (%(error)s) — a broken pack must not be skipped as if uninstalled
knobs.pack_untranslated: language pack %(lang)s is identical to English (untranslated copy)
knobs.phantom_token: token `%(token)s` appears in zreflect/*.py but is not in the knob registry — either a typo (silently ignored by every program) or a phantom knob (promised in docs, never read by code). Only a registration counts
knobs.sem.reflect_ab: spec name for the A/B same-flags gate
knobs.sem.reflect_comments: comment discipline: `mismatch` (default: explain chars <= 300 + 120*branches + 60*args) / `strict` (no docstrings) / `off` = disabled
knobs.sem.reflect_doc: living-state document (machine blocks render into it)
knobs.sem.reflect_docs: living-state documents scanned by the retraction / staleness gates
knobs.sem.reflect_doctor: doctor spec (start-of-work preflight, not a gate)
knobs.sem.reflect_history: the history carrier (single file or fold directory): the only carrier where prose is allowed (configurable path)
knobs.sem.reflect_history_mode: history carrier mode: `file` (default, single HISTORY.md) or `fold` / `folder` (exempted history folder of .md files)
knobs.sem.reflect_i18n: language pack directory (defaults to zreflect/lang shipped with the suite)
knobs.sem.reflect_i18n_root: extra source dir scanned by the language-coverage gate (repo-relative); empty = scan only the suite's own zreflect/, never the adopter's code
knobs.sem.reflect_instrument_days: constancy-detection threshold in days; empty = that rule is explicitly off
knobs.sem.reflect_instruments: measurement-method registry slot; empty = that rule is explicitly off
knobs.sem.reflect_invariants: declarative invariants spec; empty = explicitly off
knobs.sem.reflect_lang: output language pack name (e.g. zh/en); empty = null pack (the core speaks no language)
knobs.sem.reflect_langs: Languages this repo declares it serves (REFLECT_LANGS, comma-separated); unset = every installed pack counts (back-compat). Set = only the declared set is judged for completeness; other directories are self-evidence samples
knobs.sem.reflect_local_dir: consumer local extension and hook directory (default: reflect-local)
knobs.sem.reflect_locks: spec name for the locked-sources gate
knobs.sem.reflect_measure_module: collector module name (re-homing a repo changes one env line; empty = the placeholder measure_example)
knobs.sem.reflect_naked_min: bare-number threshold (integer literals below it are not checked)
knobs.sem.reflect_no_principles: set to 1 ⇒ this repo does not register the principles into the ledger (no per-commit replay); this is the explicit opt-out, do not rely on deleting PRINCIPLES.md
knobs.sem.reflect_off_gates: comma-separated pluggable gate names explicitly declared OFF
knobs.sem.reflect_phases: extra custom phases (comma separated, e.g. lab); built-in commit/start-of-work cannot be removed or duplicated
knobs.sem.reflect_pins: spec name for the derived-tree pin consistency gate
knobs.sem.reflect_readmes: the trilingual README list (cross-linked structure + same batch on every push)
knobs.sem.reflect_replay: off ⇒ the replay gate is explicitly off
knobs.sem.reflect_replay_timeout: default timeout in seconds for the verbatim executor
knobs.sem.reflect_required_gates: comma-separated gate names that are forbidden from going OFF (required on every commit/run)
knobs.sem.reflect_retired: list of retired component names; empty = that rule is explicitly off
knobs.sem.reflect_rights: spec name for the rights and license consistency gate
knobs.sem.reflect_secrets: secret-scan spec with explicit paths and exact justified exemptions; absent default file = off
knobs.sem.reflect_snapshot_root: source dir this gate scans (cross-module snapshot check). Empty ⇒ says out loud it is off
knobs.sem.reflect_stale_days: measurement-age alarm in days; empty = that rule is explicitly off
knobs.sem.reflect_world: world declaration (list of things to verify); missing file = off
knobs.sem.reflect_world_line: world line override (CI / special run modes)
knobs.usage: usage: knobs.py [--list|--selftest] (--list = every REFLECT_* knob: kind / default / meaning)
ledger.shape_incomplete: fact() shape contract (issue #5/#6): `%(name)s` and `%(name)s_expect` must be given together (only one = a half assertion; a half assertion is harder to spot than a missing one)
ledger.unreadable_gate: ledger unreadable (`%(name)s`): %(error)r — a corrupt file is not 'no ledger'; fix it before judging
lint.config_broken: static machine check cannot run (criteria file `%(path)s`): %(detail)s — that is a config accident, not 'the code has problems'
lint.no_output: ruff exited %(return_code)s with no located finding — 'the tool broke' must be distinguishable from 'no problems' (%(detail)s)
lint.off: static machine check: %(module)s not installed ⇒ explicitly off (external tool, not a dependency of this repo)
lint.off_config: static machine check: this repo has no `%(path)s` ⇒ explicitly off (this criteria set was not chosen)
lint.off_no_targets: static machine check: the suite has no declared .py files (no `MODULE =` / `GATE =` declaration anywhere) ⇒ nothing to audit ⇒ explicitly off (whole-repo fallback is forbidden, see suite_files)
lint.title: Static machine check (ruff)
locks.absent_optional: %(name)s: absent on this machine (optional ⇒ stated, not a pass)
locks.bad_form: lock %(name)s has unknown form %(form)s (expected file or dir)
locks.empty: locked list is empty (zero-value guard: an empty assertion surface is not a pass)
locks.entry_missing_field: locked entry missing field %(field)s: %(entry)r (an unexplained lock is a zombie)
locks.explicit_spec_missing: explicitly specified spec %(name)s does not exist (--spec) — write it or drop the flag
locks.no_sha256: %(name)s: file-form entry has no sha256 (that is not pinning)
locks.off: off (%(name)s does not exist ⇒ says so and exits 0; pluggable)
locks.sha_mismatch: %(name)s: sha256 mismatch (declared %(declared)s… measured %(actual)s…) — upstream bytes drifted
locks.title: Locked-sources gate
next.commits_unreadable: unpushed commits: unreadable (git unavailable or not a repo)
next.open_question: open question `%(name)s` is unsettled — read it first; do not re-raise settled ones
next.pending_none: no record — if you think there should be one, that is a gap in questions/, not 'all clear'
next.section_header: Carry-over from last turn (computed per session, nothing on disk):
next.tree_dirty: working tree is dirty — decide to commit or discard first
pins.commit_mismatch: %(name)s: derived copy commit %(declared)s ≠ worktree HEAD %(actual)s (pointer bumped after provisioning?)
pins.empty: pins is empty (zero-value guard: an empty assertion surface is not a pass)
pins.explicit_spec_missing: explicitly specified spec %(name)s does not exist (--spec / REFLECT_PINS) — write the spec or drop the flag
pins.head_unreadable: %(name)s: worktree HEAD unreadable (not a git tree?)
pins.off: off (%(name)s does not exist ⇒ says so and exits 0; pluggable)
pins.ok: pin gate: OK (%(count)d pins all consistent)
pins.title: pin gate
pins.worktree_missing: %(name)s: worktree %(path)s does not exist (the pointer is there, the tree is not)
questions.bad_parallel: %(name)s: invalid Parallel value %(actual)r (expected true or false)
questions.empty: no questions collected — empty input is not a pass (zero-value guard): check the questions/ directory first
questions.guard_empty: question files (%(count)d of them) are empty
questions.missing_settling: %(name)s: missing `Settling:` line — a question without an executable settler is only a guess
questions.no_distinct_outcomes: %(name)s: Settling gives no two distinguishable outcomes (write `… — rc=0 ⇒ A; rc=7 ⇒ B`) — describing only the procedure proves nothing
questions.none_without_first_deliverable: %(name)s: Settling says "does not exist" but does not state that it is the first deliverable — otherwise the reader does not know the next step
questions.ok: Question ledger gate: OK (%(count)d questions, %(open)d still open)
questions.resolved_cannot_be_none: %(name)s: Status is resolved while Settling says none — provide a runnable settling command or move overturned claims to HISTORY.md
questions.resolved_settler_failed: %(name)s: Status is resolved but Settling failed (rc=%(rc)s, cmd=%(cmd)s, detail=%(detail)s)
questions.settler_missing: %(name)s: the settler Settling points at does not exist: %(target)s
questions.title: Question ledger gate
readme.changed_empty: the change set of this push is empty — an empty input is not a pass (zero-value guard): 'every push must update all READMEs' cannot hold over a pile of nothing
readme.changed_file_missing: the changed-files list does not exist: %(name)s — a missing list must not count as a pass (zero-value guard)
readme.file_empty: %(name)s exists but is empty — an empty file is not a language
readme.file_missing: missing README: %(name)s — the three languages are three copies of one assertion; drop one and the assertion falls apart
readme.names_empty_push: REFLECT_READMES is empty — 'all three in the same batch' has no subject to judge (zero-value guard)
readme.names_empty_structure: REFLECT_READMES is empty — judging the 'README group' on an empty list is empty talk (zero-value guard)
readme.not_in_push: %(name)s is not among the files changed by this push ⇒ READMEs must be updated in the same batch (the strictness is intentional: miss one and the other two go stale from this moment on)
readme.off_empty_group: Trilingual README gate: REFLECT_READMES is an empty list ⇒ this repo declares no README group; standing down (unset would have used the registry default)
readme.ok_push: Trilingual README gate: OK (the push change set contains all %(count)d READMEs)
readme.ok_single: Trilingual README gate: OK (%(name)s exists and is non-empty; the switcher cross-link rule does not apply)
readme.ok_structure: Trilingual README gate: OK (all %(count)d READMEs exist, are non-empty, and cross-link correctly)
readme.switcher_incomplete: %(name)s has no reference to %(expected)s — the language switcher must point at every language, otherwise a reader cannot get from this copy to the other one
readme.switcher_not_applicable: Trilingual README gate: REFLECT_READMES has only one entry (%(name)s) ⇒ the switcher cross-link rule does not apply (with a single entry 'must point at every language' holds trivially, and self-reference is a degenerate requirement); the existence / non-empty rules still apply
readme.title: Trilingual README gate
registry.builtin_phase_repeated: %(phases)s in REFLECT_PHASES are built-in phases (commit / start-of-work cannot be duplicated and need not be re-declared) — drop them and keep only the custom phases
registry.core_gate_off: core gate(s) went OFF: %(files)s (core gates may never go OFF)
registry.empty_phase: phase %(phase)s has no runnable gates — zero-value guard: an empty list is not a pass (is the predicate or a declaration broken?)
registry.empty_roster: not a single gate was found — zero-value guard: an empty input is not a pass
registry.missing_declaration: these gates have no GATE = gate.meta(…) declaration line — the roster refuses nameless entries (handwritten rosters drift; a declaration is a registration): %(files)s
registry.name_dependent_wrong: `%(file)s` is flagged name_dependent but none of the knobs it consumes has a default name in the rename fixture list — the flag is wrong (either drop the flag or add the new default name to registry.RENAMED_DEFAULTS)
registry.no_module_selftest: no platform module self-test could be discovered — zero-value guard: an empty input is not a pass
registry.phase_error: ERROR %(file)s (executor-level breakage: rc<0 killed by signal, or >2 an unagreed code)
registry.phase_fatal: FATAL %(file)s (config/environment broken — not a check failure; different fix)
registry.phase_off_list: off(%(count)d): %(files)s (off — never checked, not a pass)
registry.phase_summary: phase %(phase)s: ran %(ran)d / off %(off)d / failed %(failed)d / fatal %(fatal)d / error %(error)d
registry.pluggable_off_undeclared: pluggable gate(s) went OFF without declaration in REFLECT_OFF_GATES: %(files)s
registry.required_gate_off: required gate(s) went OFF: %(files)s (forbidden by REFLECT_REQUIRED_GATES)
registry.selftest_no_entry: these modules declare selftest=True but have no --selftest entry point — a self-test written but never run is decoration: %(files)s
registry.selftest_no_entry_cli: [FAIL] %(file)s declares a self-test but has no --selftest entry point (written but never run = decoration)
registry.undeclared_module: these .py files are neither gates (no GATE declaration) nor declared platform modules (no MODULE = module_meta(…)) — a platform module must declare itself, even with selftest=False (state plainly that it needs no self-test): %(files)s
registry.unknown_phase: `%(file)s` declares runs_at=%(runs_at)r which is not a known phase (%(phases)s) — the frequency is a declaration field; a bad value makes the execution surface skip it
replay.bad_timeout: REFLECT_REPLAY_TIMEOUT=%(value)r is not a number ⇒ using the default %(default).0fs
replay.calibrate_command_failed: `%(key)s` instrument calibration command failed (rc=%(return_code)s): `%(command)s` — the calibration command itself is dead (a calibration must be cheap, harmless, read-only)
replay.calibrate_mismatch: `%(key)s` instrument calibration mismatch: calibrate=%(actual)s vs expected=%(expected)s — the instrument is distorted (command succeeds, value is stable, replay always "passes", yet it may not be measuring what you think; first prove the instrument can see X using a known sample that contains X, then count)
replay.calibrate_timeout: `%(key)s` instrument calibration timed out (%(seconds).0fs): `%(command)s` — a calibration must be cheap; an expensive calibration is no calibration at all
replay.empty_ledger: ledger is empty — empty is not a pass (zero-value guard): check whether measure() is broken
replay.empty_value: fact %(key)s has an empty expected value
replay.ledger_missing: fact ledger (%(name)s) is missing. Run python3 zreflect/facts.py to measure first.
replay.mismatch: `%(key)s` replay output does not match ledger: cmd=%(command)s stdout=%(actual)s vs ledger=%(expected)s — re-measure with python3 zreflect/facts.py and accept per-key (--accept-changes=k1,k2), or fix cmd bare-value stdout.
replay.no_cmd: `%(key)s` has no replay command — a fact without a cmd is prose (the bare-value contract requires it to have a cmd)
replay.none_ran: %(attempts)d attempts replayed and not a single one succeeded (all rc≠0 / timeout) — when the environment or shell is broken overall, per-entry errors masquerade as "all the data was checked" (zero-value guard)
replay.off: Replay gate: REFLECT_REPLAY=off => this gate is disabled (stated, not pretended as checked). There is no per-entry opt-out: a fact that cannot be re-run here belongs in HISTORY
replay.ok: Replay gate: OK (%(count)d facts replayed verbatim; stdout matches the ledger%(calibrated)s)
replay.principle_is_off: principle `%(key)s` came back off (not enabled): %(detail)s — off is not a pass. Command: %(command)s
replay.principle_said_nothing: principle `%(key)s` answered with nothing (empty stdout) — that cannot be told apart from 'never ran'. Command: %(command)s
replay.skip_is_gone: fact `%(key)s` sets `replay: false` -- there is no opt-out tier any more: a fact that cannot be re-run in this environment belongs in HISTORY, not in the ledger. An opt-out with a prose reason is indistinguishable from a fact that silently stopped being checked
replay.timeout: `%(key)s` replay timed out (%(seconds).0fs): `%(command)s` -- do not treat a timeout as data. Note: after a reboot the first cold-start run may time out (cold filesystem; it usually returns in a second once caches are warm) -- rerun once before judging, or raise REFLECT_REPLAY_TIMEOUT
replay.title: Replay gate
replay.too_deep: replay nesting too deep (depth %(depth)d, limit %(limit)d) — commands in the ledger form a cycle: some principle's cmd triggers replay again. Fix the ledger; do not raise the limit
retractions.evidence_not_runnable: retraction %(entry)s: `evidence` is not replayable (%(evidence)s) -- the field promises how to replay the refutation, so it must contain a python3 command
retractions.fixed_in_needs_anchor: retraction %(entry)s fixed_in %(value)r lacks a verifiable anchor (commit sha, file path, symbol, or R-id)
retractions.missing_key: `retractions.json` has no `retractions` key — a broken structure is not the same as 'no problems'
retractions.no_docs: not a single living-state document was scanned — an empty input is not a pass (zero-value guard)
retractions.ok: Retraction-resurfacing check: OK (%(count)d retractions, %(documents)d documents scanned)
retractions.resurfaced: %(name)s:%(line)d carries a retracted assertion "%(text)s" (%(entry)s): either delete it or add the correction marker
retractions.title: Retraction-resurfacing check
right.bad_default_equals: default_equals must be a non-empty string
right.copy_self: %(path)s: copy src and dst resolve to the same file
right.empty: both declarations and copies are empty (zero-value guard: an empty spec is not a pass)
right.entry_not_object: entry must be a JSON object: %(entry)r
right.explicit_spec_missing: explicitly specified spec %(name)s does not exist (--spec) — write it or drop the knob
right.missing_equals: %(path)s:%(field)s has neither equals nor top-level default_equals
right.off: off (%(name)s does not exist ⇒ says so and exits 0; pluggable)
right.ok: Rights consistency gate: OK (%(count)d checks passed)
right.title: Rights consistency gate
right.toml_unavailable: TOML support requires Python 3.11+ standard library tomllib
seal.file_tampered: sealed core file modified: `%(file)s` (sha256 mismatch; run `registry.py --reseal=%(file)s` only after authorized edit)
seal.missing: core seal `%(path)s` is missing — run `python3 zreflect/registry.py --reseal=ALL`
seal.reseal_unknown_target: reseal target not in core surface: %(file)s
seal.title: Suite Seal & Trust
seal.tree_mismatch: core seal `tree_sha256` Merkle root disagrees with file hashes in `SEAL.json`
seal.unsealed_core_file: core file `%(file)s` exists on disk but is missing from `SEAL.json`
secrets.allow_fields: allow entry needs path and rule: %(entry)r
secrets.allow_not_object: allow entry must be an object: %(entry)r
secrets.empty: no text files scanned; empty input is not a pass
secrets.finding: %(path)s:%(line)d matches %(rule)s; matched material is intentionally not printed
secrets.ignore_not_list: ignore_paths must be a list of non-empty path strings
secrets.off: secrets scan is off: default %(name)s is absent
secrets.paths_empty: paths must be a non-empty string array
secrets.spec_not_object: secrets spec must be an object
secrets.title: Secrets gate
secrets.uncovered_tracked: tracked file %(path)s is neither covered by secrets.json paths nor ignore_paths
snapshot.derived_copy: %(file)s computes `%(derived)s = …` at module level from %(source)s.%(imported)s — that expression is evaluated once at import time and never follows later changes to %(source)s.%(imported)s (compute it inside a function, or read %(source)s.%(imported)s each time)
snapshot.empty_scan: the scan surface is empty — empty is not a pass (zero-value guard)
snapshot.mutable_copy: %(file)s does `from %(source)s import %(imported)s`, which is a copy by value: %(source)s reassigns it, but the copy froze at import time (use `import %(source)s` and read `%(source)s.%(imported)s` as an attribute)
snapshot.ok: Snapshot gate: OK (%(files)d files; no cross-module copies of mutable globals)
snapshot.scan_empty_dir: scan surface %(root)s is an empty directory — an empty input is not 'no snapshot risk'
snapshot.title: Module-snapshot gate
stale.age_rule_off: staleness age: REFLECT_STALE_DAYS is not configured ⇒ this rule is not enabled (to enable: REFLECT_STALE_DAYS=days)
stale.bad_days: invalid REFLECT_STALE_DAYS=%(value)r — must be a finite non-negative number
stale.ledger_empty: ledger is empty — empty is not a pass (zero-value guard): first check whether measure() is broken
stale.ledger_missing: facts ledger missing (%(name)s). Run python3 zreflect/facts.py first to measure once.
stale.measured_at_missing: `%(key)s` has a missing or unparsable measured_at — the staleness criterion cannot be evaluated (unreadable is stated, never guessed)
stale.no_docs: not a single living-state document was scanned — empty input is not a pass (zero-value guard)
stale.ok: Stale-assertion check: OK (scanned %(count)d documents; retired names: %(declared)s)
stale.retired_name: %(name)s:%(lineno)d retired name `%(entry)s` appears in living state — either it is not retired, or this line carries a history marker
stale.retired_rule_off: R2 (retired names): REFLECT_RETIRED is not configured ⇒ this rule is not enabled (to enable: REFLECT_RETIRED=name1,name2)
stale.sha_no_facts: %(name)s:%(lineno)d sha assertion has no source: the ledger has no sha-type fact at all; measure it into the ledger first (with a replay command), then cite it
stale.sha_unsourced: %(name)s:%(lineno)d sha assertion has no source: `%(actual)s` is not in the ledger — rewrite it as a [[key]] reference, or give a verifiable source (delivery package name / backticked commit sha). Note: the word "history" is not a source (issue #25)
stale.title: Stale-assertion check
stale.too_old: `%(key)s` has not been measured for %(days)d days (threshold %(threshold)d days) — re-measure and pass `--accept-changes` explicitly
trust.suite_downgrade: suite downgrade rejected: anchored suite_seq=%(old_seq)d > incoming suite_seq=%(new_seq)d
world.active_missing: missing active (required: which line counts as current is a human decision, but the decision must be written down — not writing it = everyone guesses)
world.active_unknown: active=`%(active)s` is not in the list (known lines: %(lines)s)
world.branch_mismatch: current branch `%(branch)s` is a line in the list, but active declares `%(active)s` — the switch script did not run (or active was not updated): the world this gate is validating right now belongs to another line
world.knob_file_missing: REFLECT_WORLD is set but the declaration file is absent — write the declaration first (or drop the knob)
world.line_missing_field: line `%(line_name)s` is missing field `%(field)s` (the required four: %(fields)s)
world.lines_empty: world line list is empty or not an object — an empty list is not a pass (zero-value guard): a list must exist for a reason
world.off: world gate: not configured (REFLECT_WORLD unset and the default world.json is absent) ⇒ this gate is off (pluggable module; a single-line repo neither gains nor loses — one world = current behaviour; add world.json to enable)
world.ok: world gate: OK (line `%(line_name)s`: container `%(container)s`, site `%(site)s`, %(count)d stamps reconciled)
world.override_unknown: REFLECT_WORLD_LINE=%(line_name)s is not in the list — the override points at a line that does not exist (write it correctly or drop the knob)
world.spec_broken: world declaration %(name)s is unreadable / not valid JSON: %(error)s
world.spec_not_object: world declaration is not an object — bad shape (an object {lines, active, stamps} is required)
world.spec_shape_bad: world declaration %(name)s has a bad shape: an object {lines, active, stamps} is required
world.stamp_command_failed: stamp `%(name)s` reconciliation command failed (rc=%(return_code)s): `%(command)s` — the reconciliation method itself is dead
world.stamp_mismatch: stamp `%(name)s` mismatch: environment=%(actual)s vs declared=%(expected)s — declaration and environment disagree (the environment did not follow the switch, or it is polluted by another line); fix by re-running the switch script
world.stamp_missing_cmd: stamp `%(name)s` is missing cmd (required: the replay command that reconciles it — a stamp without cmd is prose)
world.stamp_missing_value: stamp `%(name)s` is missing value (required: one measured sample written by the switch script)
world.stamp_timeout: stamp `%(name)s` reconciliation timed out: `%(command)s` — a command wired into pre-commit must not wait forever
world.stamps_empty: stamp list is empty or not an object — a world declaration without stamps cannot hold a line switch together (zero-value guard): the three switching steps need a witness
world.title: world gate
